description: Les routes nationales dans les agglomérations de La Réunion is a dataset listed in Portail Open Data de La Réunion, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Réunion. Liste des routes nationales en agglomération à la Réunion. Données extraites du Système d'Information Routier de la Région Réunion, Direction de l'Exploitation et de l'Entretien des Routes Dernière mise à jour: juin 2025. Coverage: La Réunion. The portal files it under Transports et déplacements. Its keywords are route, rn, circulation, reseau, sig, sir. The portal shows 162 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-regionreunion-com-portal.
